execution.coarse_solve_route: the same faer full-pivot LU factors, runner-owned allocation-free single-RHS permutations, and faer unit-lower/upper triangular solves inside the frozen 71-byte factor stack schedule
execution.prior_state: the successful projected_b ProbeFactor remains retained while a replacement projected_b attempt is cancelled
execution.publication_boundary: probe-private only; production ValidatedFactor and Solved publication counts remain zero

feasible_requires: exact binding, profile, plan, checkpoint, lane, and input identities
both frozen factors enter their selected backend and complete factor plus solve
all factor and solve components are finite
reduced backward error is no greater than 64*n*2^-53
successful transient high-water bytes exactly equal the frozen peak schedule
actual private retained bytes equal the frozen publication schedule before cleanup
one outer permit is observed live inside each operation and zero after it
transient, permit, and temporary-storage residue are zero after every attempt
both one-byte-short transient grants deny before operation or backend entry
the in-flight projected_b cancellation returns Cancelled and reports host acknowledgment latency
the retained prior projected_b fingerprint and bytes are unchanged after cancellation
the failed replacement publishes nothing and final private retained residue is zero
every checkpoint bound remains the exact immutable source-level metadata for the target route

retry.before_candidate_entry: an infrastructure failure may be retried only after it is recorded
retry.after_candidate_entry: retain the attempt as an observation; do not silently retry or change the contract
